var _globals = require("@jest/globals");
var _replyVoice = require("./reply-voice");
var sentence = n => `This is sentence number ${n} of a longer answer.`;
var answer = Array.from({
  length: 40
}, (_, index) => sentence(index)).join(' ');
(0, _globals.describe)('voicePieces', () => {
  (0, _globals.test)('a short answer is one piece, nothing is lost, and an empty one is none', () => {
    (0, _globals.expect)((0, _replyVoice.voicePieces)('Just one short sentence.')).toEqual(['Just one short sentence.']);
    (0, _globals.expect)((0, _replyVoice.voicePieces)('')).toEqual([]);
    (0, _globals.expect)((0, _replyVoice.voicePieces)('  \n ')).toEqual([]);
  });
  (0, _globals.test)('the first piece is short so the first words come soon; the rest are about a paragraph each; together they are the whole text', () => {
    var pieces = (0, _replyVoice.voicePieces)(answer);
    (0, _globals.expect)(pieces.length).toBeGreaterThan(2);
    (0, _globals.expect)(pieces[0].length).toBeLessThanOrEqual(300);
    for (var piece of pieces) (0, _globals.expect)(piece.length).toBeLessThanOrEqual(_replyVoice.PIECE_CHARS);
    (0, _globals.expect)(pieces.join(' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ')).toBe(answer);
  });
  (0, _globals.test)('pieces end at sentence ends, so the voice never stops in the middle of one', () => {
    for (var piece of (0, _replyVoice.voicePieces)(answer)) (0, _globals.expect)(piece.endsWith('.')).toBe(true);
  });
  (0, _globals.test)('an enormous answer is cut at the limit instead of making hundreds of requests', () => {
    (0, _globals.expect)((0, _replyVoice.voicePieces)(answer.repeat(20)).length).toBe(_replyVoice.MAX_PIECES);
  });
  (0, _globals.test)('lines (list items, headings) stay whole pieces of text', () => {
    var lines = (0, _replyVoice.voicePieces)('First point.\nSecond point.\nThird point.');
    (0, _globals.expect)(lines.join('\n')).toBe('First point.\nSecond point.\nThird point.');
  });
});
(0, _globals.describe)('pieceFileName', () => {
  (0, _globals.test)('the same words in the same voice are the same file, a different voice or text is not', () => {
    (0, _globals.expect)((0, _replyVoice.pieceFileName)('Sulafat', 'Hello.')).toBe((0, _replyVoice.pieceFileName)('Sulafat', 'Hello.'));
    (0, _globals.expect)((0, _replyVoice.pieceFileName)('Sulafat', 'Hello.')).not.toBe((0, _replyVoice.pieceFileName)('Achird', 'Hello.'));
    (0, _globals.expect)((0, _replyVoice.pieceFileName)('Sulafat', 'Hello.')).not.toBe((0, _replyVoice.pieceFileName)('Sulafat', 'Hello!'));
    (0, _globals.expect)((0, _replyVoice.pieceFileName)('Sulafat', 'Hello.')).toMatch(/^sulafat-[a-z0-9]+\.wav$/);
  });
  (0, _globals.test)('is safe as a file name whatever the text holds', () => {
    (0, _globals.expect)((0, _replyVoice.pieceFileName)('Achird', '../../etc/passwd "quotes" ñ 日本語 \n')).toMatch(/^achird-[a-z0-9]+\.wav$/);
  });
});
